name: @pierre/diffs
summary: Open-source library for rendering code diffs on the web, built on Shiki with React and vanilla JS APIs.
description: Library for rendering code and diffs in the browser: stacked (unified) and split (side-by-side) layouts, inline change highlighting, merge-conflict resolution UI, comments and annotations, line selection, virtualization and SSR. Syntax highlighting and theming come from Shiki; React components and vanilla JS classes share the same lower-level renderers, and an edit mode (beta) adds undo history, find-in-file and lint markers.
contains: diff and code rendering for React and vanilla JS
edit mode (beta) with undo history, find-in-file and lint markers
token hover hooks, worker-pool highlighting, SSR preload
agent skill and plain-text docs for coding agents
